_about: Known accessibility violations the check tolerates. Each entry needs: path (one page such as /about/ or /es/about/; "*" is not allowed), rule (axe rule id), selector (an exact axe target) or html (at least 12 characters of the element's HTML), reason (at least 20 characters), added (YYYY-MM-DD) and review_by (YYYY-MM-DD, after added and at most 90 days later). Unknown keys fail. An expired or unmatched entry fails the check. Only the owner approves new entries.
